leaf_kind: prose explanation string (non-numeric); explains why an item's represented mechanic contributes nothing to outgoing TDD
old_value: The represented mechanic changes defense, not outgoing TDD.
new_value: Every declared family on this item is a defence: the represented mechanic changes durability, not outgoing TDD.

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

independent_computation.step_0_scope_limit: The scenario tuple 'syndra_derived_order_60' is not defined anywhere inside data/ or docs/math-foundations.md (grep for 'syndra_derived_order_60', 'coupled_scenario', 'item_coverage', 'utility_outcomes' over the whole export returns nothing but data/worklists/e9-bis-b-task.md, which only describes item_coverage as a verdict+reason layer). The concrete item behind item_coverage[0] therefore cannot be named from the permitted sources; the leaf was adjudicated on (a) the semantic claim each string makes and (b) whether that claim is true for the class of items the string can be emitted for, enumerated from cached data.
independent_computation.step_1_what_TDD_is: docs/math-foundations.md sec 3.1 defines the optimizer objective as f(S) = 'the coupled participant-timeline score: deterministic total damage dealt by the main participant before its own death, summed over the fight window, with an infinitesimal effective-health tiebreak (score + EHP*1e-9)'. So outgoing TDD is a strictly attacker-side outgoing-damage quantity; holder-side durability (resists, shields, spell shields, stasis/invulnerability) enters ONLY through survival time and the 1e-9 EHP tiebreak, never as an outgoing-damage term. Both strings' shared operative conclusion ('not outgoing TDD') is therefore correct for any purely self-protective mechanic.
independent_computation.step_2_declared_families_are_a_real_data: data/atoms/classification-report.json declares the family vocabulary ['crowd-control-mobility','damage','heal-shield','interaction','stack-transform-summon-resource','vision-economy'], and every per-item file data/item-atoms/<id>.json carries an explicit 'family' on each declared atom (plus 'stats' for stat lines). So 'every declared family on this item' names a checkable per-item property in the cached data, not a rhetorical flourish.
independent_computation.step_3_enumerate_the_pure_defence_class: Scanning all 325 data/item-atoms/*.json for items whose non-stat declared families are a subset of the defensive family {heal-shield} yields 8 items: Banshee's Veil, Bloodthirster, Divine Sunderer, Eclipse, Goredrinker, Spirit Visage, Verdant Barrier, Wordless Promise. Of these, the ones whose declared effect is *only* defence (no damage/on-hit family anywhere) and that are AP/mid-legal for a Syndra utility build are Banshee's Veil (3102) and its component Verdant Barrier (4632). Banshee's Veil declares exactly: stats.ability-power, stats.magic-resistance, heal-shield.heal-and-shield-power [Annul], heal-shield.shield [Annul], heal-shield.shield-magic [Annul] — i.e. every declared effect family is heal-shield, a defence, with zero damage-family atoms.
independent_computation.step_4_cached_wiki_text: data/items.json 3102 Banshee's Veil, passives[0] 'Annul': 'Grants a {{tip|spell shield}} that blocks the next hostile ability (40 second cooldown, timer restarts upon taking damage from champions).' simpleDescription: 'Periodically blocks enemy abilities'. This is entirely incoming-side: it blocks a hostile ability. Nothing in the effect text adds damage, penetration, amplification, or resistance shred to the holder's outgoing damage. Contrast a genuinely TDD-relevant 'defense' item, Abyssal Mask (8020) 'Unmake': 'Enemy champions ... receive 12% increased magic damage from all sources' — that one declares a damage-family atom (damage.magic) and DOES change outgoing TDD.
independent_computation.step_5_adjudicate_the_wording: The old string says the mechanic 'changes defense'. Unpossessed 'defense' is ambiguous between the holder's defense and the target's defense. The target's defense is a first-class TDD term: docs/math-foundations.md line 457 states the mitigation identity m(R)=100/(100+R), so anything that changes the target's R (armor shred, MR shred, %/flat pen, Abyssal Mask-style amplification) changes outgoing TDD directly. Read that way the old sentence is self-contradicting ('changes defense, not outgoing TDD'). The new string removes the ambiguity two ways: 'durability' is unambiguously holder-side, and the prefix states the actual, checkable test that licenses the conclusion — every family the item declares is a defence, hence no damage-family term exists to feed the outgoing-damage sum.
independent_computation.step_6_falsification_attempt: The new string is false only if the item declares a non-defensive family. The verified pure-defence class in step 3 has no damage-family atoms, so the universal claim holds there. Two caveats recorded for completeness, neither of which overturns the verdict: (a) the claim is only sound when 'declared family' is scoped to declared *effect* families — nearly every defensive item also carries offensive stat lines (Banshee's Veil declares stats.ability-power 105), so a reading that swept 'stats' into the quantifier would be false for essentially every item; (b) Zhonya's Hourglass (3157), the other archetypal mage defensive item, declares crowd-control-mobility.stasis AND damage.resistance-mitigation for 'Time Stop', so if item_coverage[0] were Zhonya's the literal 'every declared family is a defence' would be strained under the atom taxonomy (though damage.resistance-mitigation is a mitigation behavior, i.e. still holder-side durability, and Time Stop still adds nothing to outgoing TDD).
independent_computation.conclusion: The operative assertion shared by both strings — a self-protective mechanic contributes nothing to outgoing TDD — is confirmed by docs/math-foundations.md sec 3.1 and by the cached effect text. The new string is at least as true as the old on every reading and strictly more precise: it replaces the ambiguous 'defense' (which, read as the target's defense, would be flatly wrong per the m(R)=100/(100+R) identity) with holder-side 'durability', and it names the checkable data property (all declared families defensive) that justifies the exclusion. No numeric quantity is involved, so no value is recomputed.

caveats: The scenario tuple for 'syndra_derived_order_60' lives outside the permitted export, so the specific item at item_coverage[0] could not be named; the verdict rests on the semantic claim plus the enumerated pure-defence item class in data/item-atoms/.

'Every declared family' must be scoped to declared effect families, not stat lines — otherwise the quantifier would be false for any defensive item that also grants AP/AD/haste (e.g. Banshee's Veil's 105 AP).

If item_coverage[0] were Zhonya's Hourglass, its Time Stop declares crowd-control-mobility.stasis plus damage.resistance-mitigation; the 'not outgoing TDD' conclusion still holds, but the literal universal quantifier would be looser than for a heal-shield-only item.
